'''Saber Enterprises''' appeared to be a legitimate corporation headed by [[Renik]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], but in fact it was a front for much of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] counter-espionage operations.<ref name="sb" />

==History==
[[Guri]], following orders by [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], paid 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Chief Technician]] [[Viera Cheran]] in order to program [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson's]] [[Unidentified R2 unit (Wes Janson)|R2]] droid to shoot [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="sb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

The payment, initiated by an agent in Renik working for [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], aided by [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Perit]]'s [[slicer/Legends|slicers]] followed routes through Renik's dummy corporations;<ref name="sb" /> after Cheran's plot was uncovered, the payment was ultimately traced to Saber Enterprises, showing that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] supposedly wanted Luke dead.
